trend_risk.title: Trend & Technical Risk
trend_risk.methodology: Compares current price to 250-day simple moving average (long-term regime), 20-day rate of change (ROC20 momentum), and distance to 3.0x ATR14 trailing volatility stop.
trend_risk.explanation: The stock is trading 3.2% above its 250-day moving average. Technical signal is EXIT with a 6.8% buffer before triggering trailing stop rules.

financial_risk.title: Financial Health & Balance Sheet Risk
financial_risk.methodology: Evaluates solvency leverage (Net Debt/EBITDA), debt service buffer (Interest Coverage), organic cash conversion (Operating Cash Flow / Net Income > 1.0 signifies high earnings quality), and 1-year share dilution rate.
financial_risk.evidence: Net Debt=$6.97B, Net Debt/EBITDA=0.5805483687045312x, Interest Coverage=18.606927710843372x, Earnings Quality (OCF/NI)=1.3392008752877511x, Dilution YoY=-3.5040431266846306%.
financial_risk.explanation: Net debt of $7.0B. Earnings quality of 1.34x indicates net income is strongly supported by real operating cash flows.

market_risk.title: Market & Macroeconomic Risk
market_risk.methodology: Calculates 5-year maximum peak-to-trough drawdown, 252-day covariance Beta relative to SPY, annualized realized volatility (std * sqrt(252)), downside capture ratio during negative market days, and stress drawdowns during COVID-19 (Feb-Mar 2020) and 2022 Tech Bear market.
market_risk.explanation: The stock has a beta of 2.11 relative to the S&P 500 with realized volatility of 54.4%. Historical 5-year peak drawdown was -45.1%. Downside capture is 131%, indicating higher sensitivity on negative market days.
